about_the_game: The reel may be spinning, but the projector is dead. And where your eyes don't work, you must let your ears fill in. Deep Cuts features music from the soundtrack not featured in the movie chapters. This may be ambience to certain areas, boss fight music, end credits score, and so on. Dig into the popcorn and hit play for a diverse collection of songs!
